$description: Structured representation of Contera's Threshold design tokens. Derived from context/design-system.md. Non-authoritative — see context/manifest.md §7. Only extracts what the source material actually defines; gaps are represented explicitly (null / empty) with a note, per context/design-system.md 'What this document does not define'. Do not treat a null/empty field as an oversight or fill it with an invented value.

accent-50.usage: Reserved, not yet assigned a use

accent-200.usage: The Prepared-tier thread, and the tier-signal icon and label that accompany it.

accent-500.usage: Exactly two things, anywhere in the product: the Approve/Send action's fill, and the Approval tier's label color. Nothing else may use it at full strength.

accent-on-dark.usage: Supplementary text/icon accents on a dark (Approval-tier) surface.

resolved_state_glyphs.note: Render as icon/text color only. A colored background chip is not a valid use of either token, in any tier.

voices.name: Display
voices.usage: The one hero title per screen — the thing the record is (equipment name, etc.). Not card titles.

voices.name: Eyebrow / field label
voices.usage: Structural labels — never the value itself.

voices.name: Systematic
voices.usage: Every value that is data rather than prose: dates/times, currency, rental/reservation/unit IDs, meter readings, phone numbers, counts, percentages, evidence/source citations.

type.systematic_test: If a value could be looked up, counted, compared, or copied, set it in mono with tabular numerals. If it's a sentence a human wrote or reads as prose, it's Body. If it names what you're looking at, it's Display or a Section label.
type.scale_status: DEFINED — implemented and exercised across every screen type in the prototype (Reservation Detail baseline, Feature 001 Generations 1-3, Design Exploration A/B/C, Compare).

scale.selection_basis: Controlled three-option Figma comparison (Compact 14/13/11, Readable 16/14/12, Balanced 15/13/11) against real FEATURE-001 content; chosen for rapid comprehension on operational surfaces.

display.note: unchanged, not part of this test

eyebrow.note: held constant during the comparison; not independently validated against 16px neighbors

systematic.note: inherits the size of the role it plays — not an independent tier

hero_stat.note: unchanged for now; step-up over body content has compressed relative to the prior 14px baseline, recheck before promoting

scale.operational_density_principle: Contera's operational surfaces optimize typography for rapid comprehension before maximum information density; more compact scales may suit expert/technical surfaces where density carries more task value. Which surfaces count as which is not yet enumerated.

icons.note: An icon never carries meaning alone; always sits beside a text label.

spacing.note: An early Figma proof-of-concept had a construction artifact that rendered some gaps larger than these values; treat as evaluation history, not a measurement of these tokens. V3 must visually validate the actual implemented values.

ladder.relationship: two elements forming one semantic unit
separate elements within the same content group
peer fields/columns within a row, or stacked cards in a column
start of a genuinely new information group

spacing.decision_status: four-level semantic ladder derived from the selected spacing direction and subsequent controlled refinements; WORKING_HYPOTHESIS pending code implementation and second-screen validation

field_label_to_value_gap.note: Tighter than and separate from the ladder above — a label always directly captions its own value, not a general content relationship.

field_row_column_gap.decision_rationale: 16px selected over 24px after a controlled comparison with everything else held constant: 24px produced no meaningful improvement in scanability, wrapping, card height, or field distinction at the tested card width, while consuming additional horizontal space.

surface_padding.note: Deliberately asymmetric — compact horizontally, calm vertically. Not a step toward general spaciousness.

related_stack.confirmed_pairing: payment method caption + its metadata line
related_stack.implementation_note: Build as an independent nested container with its own gap value, not a shared base spacing value plus a compensating adjustment.

hero_stat_pattern.note: Tried in exactly one place — the Reservation Detail header's 'Scheduled return.' Not yet promoted to DEFINED.
hero_stat_pattern.selection_test: The figure a counter employee scans for first when opening this specific record — not 'the most important field,' but the one the visit is usually for.

undefined_token_categories.note: These are gaps in the source material, not omissions from this file. Do not fill with an invented value. See context/design-system.md 'What this document does not define'.
undefined_token_categories.spacing_scale: WORKING_HYPOTHESIS — see top-level 'spacing' field; not yet DEFINED
